title: Unify chat input normalization across Agent and Agent-team Skill execution
goal: Ensure Agent-team execution receives the same normalized, fail-closed natural-language payload as single-Agent Skill execution, so polite file commands preserve exact content.
context: M8 runChatSkillIfMatched passes SkillRuntime.chatInputText through its text input, but runChatTeamIfMatched passed raw inputContext or goalStatement. This made team execution inconsistent with the canonical single-Agent path for polite lead-ins and colon-delimited payload extraction.
forbidden_changes: Do not widen Agent Skill scope or workspace capabilities.
Do not change file path validation, policy, approval, cancellation, or output verification.
Do not modify UI, provider/GGUF, or unrelated runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Agent-team Skill input uses the same SkillRuntime.chatInputText normalization as the single-Agent path.
A polite Vietnamese team file-creation request creates the exact requested file content and returns a verified Skill result.
Existing workspace-disabled and fail-closed team tests remain passing.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the regression fails, preserve exact file-content assertions and fail-closed workspace policy; fix only the shared input normalization boundary.
